title: Synthetic weak cryptographic hash evaluation
why_code_is_vulnerable: The function hashes arbitrary audit-record strings with hashlib.md5 after UTF-8 encoding. MD5 is cryptographically broken and unsuitable for security-sensitive hashing, and Bandit flags this as B324.
expected_vulnerable_test_outcome: The functional test passes because the same synthetic input produces the same MD5 digest across calls. The security test fails because the expected secure SHA-256 digest does not match the insecure MD5 output.
final_repair_success_criteria: No new high-severity security finding is introduced.
